subheadline: Four people, each with one area: components, themes, accessibility and TYPO3 integrations.

members.name: Lea Fischer
members.bio: Designed the ten house presets, from Aurora to Citrus, and the colour token scale that keeps dark mode consistent in each of them.

image.title: Lea Fischer
image.alternative: A woman in her thirties with light-brown hair tied back and a navy blouse.

members.name: Mara Weiss
members.bio: Built most of the 17 atoms and 37 molecules. She keeps the component API small, so 244 elements can share the same parts.

image.title: Mara Weiss
image.alternative: A woman in her late thirties with a dark-brown bob and an olive-green knit top.

members.name: Noah Ritter
members.bio: Runs the template audit and screen-reader checks. He works with engineers so fixes land before an element ships, not after.

image.title: Noah Ritter
image.alternative: A man in his thirties with short dark-blond hair, a trimmed beard and a navy sweater.

members.name: Jonas Klein
members.bio: Maintains the News, Solr, Powermail and blog integrations and the seed command that builds this styleguide.

image.title: Jonas Klein
image.alternative: A young man with short dark-brown hair and a dark shirt, looking slightly to one side.
